user.title: Connect to Orbit Home
user.description: Sign in with your Orbit Home account. Your opener must already be paired in the Orbit app. New installations start with status only and a disabled native activation button. Guarded GDO Open/Close requires a separate opt-in under Configure; reauthentication preserves your settings.

init.title: Guarded garage control
init.description: Enable only after attended validation on every GDO door in this account. Open/Close uses a state-guarded toggle, not native directional commands. Stale cloud data and physical-remote races remain possible. NOVA/NVMini stay status-only. Changing this setting reloads the integration and resets in-memory interlocks: first inspect the door and ensure it is stationary. HomeKit does not inherit arrival location/expiry checks.

data.enable_directional_controls: Enable guarded Open/Close for validated GDO doors
